$comment: Structural speed budgets checked by perf-smoke (bun scripts/perf/smoke.ts) on the 100-document fixture. Counts, not timings: they do not depend on the runner's speed. Rewrite with bun scripts/perf/smoke.ts --update; a budget that rises needs a "why" on its entry, which bun run perf:guards checks.

requests.why: Requests per click (API, HTML frame and page loads; cached assets aside). Each extra request is a round trip on a phone, 150 ms or more.

chain.why: Requests a click's content waited for one after another once clicked (in-tab clicks and reopening the app; a hover's early requests aside). Plan 15 target: at most one on a click's critical path.

revisit content.why: Opening a document again reads its content from the browser cache (documents by revision, #113 and #117).

idle requests.why: Requests from an untouched tab at Home in 75 s. Plan 15 target: about one a minute; Home checks Pending, Recent and Activity every 60 s while it has no socket (registered in perf:guards).

redirects.why: A redirect adds a round trip before anything loads (Plan 16 gate D5).

cold js.why: JavaScript files a cold page load fetches before content. Each file is a request the phone waits on before any data.

dom.why: Elements once a screen settles. Long lists render only what is visible (W3-05); layout cost grows with the element count.

popin.why: On revisits, frames in which content becomes visible (0.1% of the screen or more) after the screen's content showed, until it settles. A revisit renders from what the tab holds and should show its final screen at once.

indicators.why: On revisits, loading episodes (skeletons, spinners, busy regions; parts that appear together count once) from the click until the screen settles. A revisit should show none.

io stat.why: File stats per hot request, solo owner. Plan 16 gate D4 and the Plan 17 per-request I/O work.

io read.why: File opens, reads and directory reads per hot request, solo owner. Hot reads come from derived data, not files (docs/performance.md).

io sql.why: SQL statements per hot request, solo owner, Better Auth's included.

cold js, open the app at Home.why: The sidebar's Getting Started row and its progress ring share a small chunk with the member welcome, so every page loads one more file. Configured avatars share one additional 1.1 KB gzip graphics module; identity metadata reuses the existing workspace response. Removing the earlier single-link share dialog took its inputs, dialog shell and clipboard helper out of the always-loaded share button chunk. The sidebar and other eager screens still use them, so the bundler now emits them as five small shared chunks preloaded in parallel: the same code, 4 KB more in total.

dom, cold, open the app at Home.why: Each Space icon and person avatar sits on its recognition color, one more element per Space row and avatar.

cold js, open Space.why: Configured agent logos, custom icons and person avatars share one 1.1 KB gzip graphics module loaded by the sidebar; identity metadata reuses the existing workspace response. Removing the earlier single-link share dialog took its inputs, dialog shell and clipboard helper out of the always-loaded share button chunk. The sidebar and other eager screens still use them, so the bundler now emits them as five small shared chunks preloaded in parallel: the same code, 4 KB more in total.

requests, cold, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): a deep link to an image's file page. The page check, the app's boot reads and the image.

cold js, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): a file's page loads the Doc renderer's code and its own, 2 files more than a Markdown doc.

requests, cold, open a Doc with images.why: New journey (Plan 21): a deep link to a Markdown Doc that embeds two images. The Markdown doc's requests plus one per image.

requests, cold, open an HTML Doc with im.why: New journey: a deep link to an HTML Doc that names two Space images. The HTML doc's requests: the images come inside its frame.

cold js, open a Doc with images.why: New journey (Plan 21): the same code as a Markdown doc.

cold js, open an HTML Doc with images.why: New journey: the same code as an HTML doc.

cold js, open Threads.why: Comments show their messages with the Threads Markdown renderer, so the bundler moves that renderer out of the Threads chunk into one both share: one more small chunk on a cold open of Threads, preloaded with the rest, and none on revisits. Before that, removing the single-link share dialog split its inputs, dialog shell and clipboard helper into five small shared chunks.

cold js, open a thread.why: Comments show their messages with the Threads Markdown renderer, so the bundler moves that renderer out of the Threads chunk into one both share: one more small chunk on a cold open of Threads, preloaded with the rest, and none on revisits. Before that, removing the single-link share dialog split its inputs, dialog shell and clipboard helper into five small shared chunks.

dom, first, open the app at Home.why: Each Space icon and person avatar sits on its recognition color, one more element per Space row and avatar.

dom, first, open a Space in the sidebar.why: The fixture gained a Doc and two image files under perf/ (Plan 21 journeys), which add rows to the lists this screen shows.

dom, first, open Space.why: Each Space icon and person avatar sits on its recognition color, one more element per Space row and avatar.

dom, first, open Markdown doc.why: Each Space row in the sidebar carries its pin button (hover-revealed on desktop), and groups add their labels: about 60 elements on the fixture.

dom, first, open rich doc.why: Each Space icon and person avatar sits on its recognition color, one more element per Space row and avatar.

dom, first, open HTML doc.why: The sidebar shows each Space row's pin button (hover-revealed on desktop) and the person's group labels.

requests, first, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): the page check and the image.

chain, first, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): the image waits on the page check, which a hover starts early, so one step after the click.

dom, first, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): an image's file page.

requests, first, open a Doc with images.why: New journey (Plan 21): the Doc's content, page check and annotations, and the image the file page did not already load.

requests, first, open an HTML Doc with i.why: New journey: the HTML doc's requests. The images come inside its frame, so none of their own.

chain, first, open a Doc with images.why: New journey (Plan 21): the images wait on the Doc's content, which a hover starts early, so one step after the click.

chain, first, open an HTML Doc with imag.why: New journey: the frame waits on the page check, as an HTML doc's does.

dom, first, open a Doc with images.why: New journey (Plan 21): a Markdown Doc with two images.

dom, first, open an HTML Doc with images.why: New journey: the HTML doc's screen; the images are inside its frame.

dom, first, back to Home.why: Each Space icon and person avatar sits on its recognition color, one more element per Space row and avatar.

dom, first, open Threads.why: Each Space icon and person avatar sits on its recognition color, one more element per Space row and avatar.

dom, first, open a thread.why: The fixture gained a Doc and two image files under perf/ (Plan 21 journeys). The journeys before this one open perf/ and perf/files/, so the sidebar shows their rows.

chain, revisit, open a Space in the side.why: The Settings journeys lengthen the pass, so the revisit now comes more than 5 minutes after the first open. By then the closed Space's contents were collected (React Query's default 5-minute gcTime), and opening it waits for them again, as on a real instance. The next performance round targets this (Plan 15e).

requests, revisit, open HTML doc.why: The perf browser now trusts the proxy's certificate, so its HTTP cache works as a browser's does. The HTML doc's frame comes from it: the page check and annotations.

chain, revisit, open HTML doc.why: The perf browser now trusts the proxy's certificate, so its HTTP cache works as a browser's does. Nothing waits on a download.

requests, revisit, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): the page check. The image comes from the browser's cache at its versioned address.

chain, revisit, open a file page.why: New journey (Plan 21): the image comes from the browser's cache, so nothing waits on the page check.

requests, revisit, open a Doc with image.why: New journey (Plan 21): the page check and annotations. The images come from the browser's cache at their versioned addresses.

requests, revisit, open an HTML Doc with.why: New journey: the page check and annotations. The frame, images included, comes from the browser's cache at its revision.

chain, revisit, open a Doc with images.why: New journey (Plan 21): the images come from the browser's cache, so nothing waits on the page check.

chain, revisit, open an HTML Doc with im.why: New journey: the frame comes from the browser's cache, so nothing waits on a download.

requests, reopen, open the app at Home.why: The quick-click journey leaves a third Space open in the sidebar, so the reopened app also loads its contents. The sidebar reopens the Spaces a person left open, and each loads its tree (Space, docs, documents, records). The journey leaves two Spaces open.
